abstract: Interdisciplinary research collaboration is crucial for scientific innovation, but it remains difficult to initiate in practice. Existing collaborator discovery approaches are often constrained by disciplinary boundaries and static researcher profiles that do not reflect the specific context of a new collaboration goal. As a result, researchers struggle to translate open-ended collaboration goals into domain-specific tasks, evaluate candidate researchers' fit and complementarity, and establish common ground before initial contact. To address these challenges, we present DeepConnect, an LLM-augmented visual analytics system for interdisciplinary collaborator discovery. DeepConnect translates collaboration ideas into domain-specific tasks, retrieves relevant papers to ground cross-domain exploration, and provides coordinated visualizations for exploring and comparing candidate researchers. It further reveals terminology gaps and overlaps across domains and supports publication-grounded conversation rehearsal to help users prepare for outreach. We evaluate DeepConnect through two case studies, a user study, and a component-level evaluation, showing its value for complementary team formation, idea refinement, and pre-contact preparation. The DeepConnect website is available at https://deepconnect.sg.

ur.tldr: 针对跨学科合作难以发起的问题，提出LLM增强的可视化分析系统DeepConnect，将合作想法自动转化为领域任务、检索相关论文以支持跨域探索，并提供协同可视化比较候选研究者、揭示跨领域术语差异与重叠、支持基于论文的对话演练以帮助联系准备。通过案例研究、用户研究和组件级评估验证了其在互补团队组建、想法精炼和联系前准备方面的价值。

title: DeepConnect: A Visual Analytics System for Bridging Interdisciplinary Research Collaborations
title_zh: DeepConnect：面向跨学科研究协作的视觉分析系统
